glosses: federal, federative (of or relating to a federation, a form of government that divides a sovereign state into smaller, local, autonomous unities such as states/provinces and municipalities/counties that are subject to a higher nationwide sphere, the federal sphere)
federal (of or relating to the higher sphere of a country instead of lower, local ones; often used with upper case initials in phrases like Governo Federal, Polícia Federal, Justiça Federal etc.)

examples.text: O treze é um número de sorte na Loteria Federal Brasileira.
examples.en: Thirteen is a lucky number in the Brazilian Federal Lottery.
